title: Kenyan Beer-Braised Dumplings
description: A hearty Kenyan-inspired dish featuring tender dumplings slow-cooked in a rich beer-based sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add flour and stir to coat beef, cooking for 1 minute.
Gradually add beer, stirring to combine.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Add dumpling wrappers, one at a time, and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until dough is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Note: Cooking time may vary depending on the size of the dumplings.
